feature_definitions.bbo_update_intensity: book-change row count per panel bin
feature_definitions.depth_policy: full-depth metrics only from valid depth_snapshots; last snapshot inside current panel bin; no cross-bin depth carry; BBO changes never treated as full depth
feature_definitions.depth_update_intensity: full-depth snapshot count per panel bin
feature_definitions.fill_activity: unsigned count and source value_usd per panel bin
feature_definitions.large_residual_change: absolute semantic residual change >= 2.0 standard deviations using the same discovery event/regime/resolution residual-change scale; threshold is fixed and not searched
feature_definitions.logit_movement: current logit midpoint minus one-resolution-prior logit midpoint
feature_definitions.quote_batch_rule: same-observed_at conflicting BBO states are invalid until a later unambiguous BBO
feature_definitions.top_depth: top bid level size and top ask level size from full snapshot
feature_definitions.venue_trade_activity: unsigned count and price*size notional per panel bin

large_response_artifact_rule: full directed response cells are written externally as deterministic CSV; committed response_matrix.csv is a deterministic group summary plus predeclared strongest cells

multiple_comparisons.family: event x regime x metric family

null_calibration_statistic.reason: predeclared canonical null-calibration slice; full descriptive structure still reports every supported resolution
statistics: mean absolute off-diagonal contemporaneous price-change correlation
mean absolute directed next-30s price-change correlation

NULL_A_CIRCULAR_SHIFT.scope: independent market series within one event/regime/resolution

matching_priority: same unordered market-family pair where possible
pair coverage within 20 percent where possible
geometric-mean activity within factor 2 where possible
deterministic nearest coverage/activity distance then condition IDs

panel_output_policy: compact diagnostics in Git; large panel/intermediates external
propagation_network_rule: retain all available directed pair responses; node source/sink diagnostics use mean absolute outgoing/incoming price-response strength without P&L or significance filtering
